nodes.rationale: Generated with the built-in image generator on 2026-09-11 after Higgsfield proved unavailable. Saved as an artwork candidate only; the login page's SVG has not been replaced and rendered shading is not pixel-exact token color. The prompt constrains the palette to the Brand tokens with exactly one amber synaptic highlight and explicitly excludes MRI imagery, human brain silhouettes and generic stock shapes.
